source.source_name: SARAS Reporting Portal (reportal.ge) — public financial statements
source.organization: Service for Accounting, Reporting and Auditing Supervision (SARAS), Ministry of Finance of Georgia

transport.rate_limit: public via browser; search requires anti-forgery token

parsing.notes: Official SARAS public financial-statements portal. Browser-public search by identification code / name, but automation is gated: the simple search POST (/en/Base/Search) needs an __RequestVerificationToken; the detailed search GET (/en/Reports/List with orgName, year, legalFormId, naceCodes) returned 404 for guessed URLs. An API host rms.reportal.ge exists but guessed endpoints 404'd. Discover the real search/data endpoint and handle the anti-forgery token/session; do NOT bypass controls. Financials are inside filed PDFs (GEL). Join to NAPR on the 9-digit identification code.

fixture_requirements: public-interest entity with multiple reporting years
report with both financial statements and management report PDFs

live_test_plan.smoke: Load /en/Reports, obtain the __RequestVerificationToken, and POST a name search; or identify the detailed-search GET endpoint.
live_test_plan.full: Blocked on transport discovery — resolve the search/data endpoint + token handling; download report PDFs and parse financials (GEL).

blockers: Search POST requires an anti-forgery token; detailed-search GET endpoint not resolved (404 for guessed URLs)
